correctness.rationale: The claim concerns projectivized nonzero complex symmetric matrices with n>=2 and 1<=r<=n. The diagonal C-star congruence action with weights 2^i gives distinct projective weights 2^i+2^j: the binary representation separates diagonals from unordered off-diagonals. The n diagonal fixed points have matrix rank one, the n(n-1)/2 off-diagonal fixed points have rank two. Euler-characteristic fixed-point localization for projective complex varieties, including singular ones, gives n at r=1 and n(n+1)/2 for all r>=2; constructible additivity gives exact-rank n, C(n,2), and 0 thereafter. Verified n=2 (full rank bound ambient P^2) and r=n, including degenerate empty strata; independent distinct-weight check n=2..10. No inference from finite checks to arbitrary n: binary uniqueness and localization are the infinite proof.
